notes: §1985:VI.5.15.4 GR1 requires (a) "If the category of the item is numeric, all literals in the VALUE clause must be numeric", (b) for an alphabetic, alphanumeric, alphanumeric edited or numeric edited item "all literals in the VALUE clause must be nonnumeric literals. The literal is aligned in the data item as if the data item had been described as alphanumeric", the editing characters having "no effect on initialization of the data item", and (c) "Initialization is not affected by any BLANK WHEN ZERO or JUSTIFIED clause that may be specified". Every VALUE literal of every format (item, group, level 88, both ends of a THRU range) passes DataBinder.ScreenValueLiteral into ValidateValueCategory, which refuses a nonnumeric literal or a character figurative on a numeric subject and a numeric literal on an alphabetic, alphanumeric or alphanumeric-edited subject (COBOL1657, an error unless --permissive); the 1985 arm is ScreenNumericEditedNumericLiteral, which asks the construct registry and refuses a numeric literal (the literal zero included) on a numeric-edited subject below 2023 (COBOL0900), and it reaches a PIC 9 item made numeric edited by BLANK WHEN ZERO (§1985:VI.5.4.4 GR2). ValueInitializer.InitializerFrom stores a nonnumeric literal verbatim, left-aligned and space-filled to the item's size with no JUSTIFIED, editing or BLANK WHEN ZERO step, and scales a numeric literal to the item's decimal point. The witness runs a JUSTIFIED RIGHT item and a numeric-edited item with an edited-form literal; probes at --std 85 added 14 refusals (each literal class against each category, level 88 included) and a run over alphabetic, alphanumeric-edited, numeric-edited with BLANK WHEN ZERO, figurative and group-member cases, all as the rule states.

next.reason: 1985: for a numeric-edited item 'all literals in the VALUE clause must be nonnumeric literals', and 'Initialization is not affected by any BLANK WHEN ZERO or JUSTIFIED clause'. §2023:13.18.63.3 SR6: for numeric-edited, literals 'may be numeric' and are converted to edited form by the MOVE rules (editing applied, §2023:13.18.63.3 SR11), and then BLANK WHEN ZERO 'does affect initialization' of a zero value (§2023:13.18.63.4 GR8 NOTE 1; §2023:13.18.63.3 SR8). Looser: a numeric literal that 1985 refuses is accepted, with a BWZ effect 1985 never had. Kept: numeric literals for numeric (SR2), alphanumeric literals for alphabetic/alphanumeric/alphanumeric-edited (SR4), numeric-edited alphanumeric literal (SR7), alignment without JUSTIFIED or editing (§2023:13.18.63.4 GR7), and BWZ inert for an alphanumeric literal.
